name: CoQA
intro: CoQA 是对话式阅读理解 benchmark，报告中作为 QA 能力评测项出现。
build_method: 七域段落筛选, 双人对话众包, 多答案复标
task_type: 对话式问答, 阅读理解
build_method_en: Seven-domain passage curation, paired conversational crowdsourcing, multi-answer re-annotation
intro_en: CoQA is a conversational reading-comprehension benchmark referenced as a QA evaluation item in technical reports.
drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:1808.07042 Sections 3 and 6. CoQA selects multi-entity passages from seven domains, reserves Reddit and Science for out-of-domain testing, and pairs qualified questioners and answerers in real time. Questioners are prompted to paraphrase; answerers highlight a rationale and edit it into a free-form answer. The corpus has 8,399 conversations and 127K turns. Every Dev/Test question receives three additional answers, so normalized macro word-overlap F1 averages across four references after removing articles and punctuation.
